# Loan Math

Loan Math is a free online calculator site that explains the mathematics of borrowing — amortization schedules, interest mechanics and APR, worked out in the open — plus the full library of 154 calculators. Every figure is an estimate, not a loan offer or financial advice.

Made for borrowers, home buyers, car buyers and students who want to understand how a loan is computed before they sign anything.

All 154 calculators are free, with no account or sign-up. Every calculator shows its formula or method and at least one worked example.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://loanmath.website/): all 154 calculators, organized by category.
- [Embed these calculators](https://loanmath.website/embed.html): put any of the 154 Loan Math calculators on your own site for free — no account, no attribution required.
- [Partnerships](https://loanmath.website/partnerships.html): the network Loan Math belongs to, and how to partner with us.
- [Creator ROI Hub — Earnings, Sponsorship & Fee Calculators](https://loanmath.website/creator-roi-calculators.html): The Creator ROI Hub: free calculators for people who publish for a living — YouTube and TikTok earnings, sponsorship rates, payment fees and AI API costs, with honest ranges and the math shown.
